headline: True-positive attack from 185.220.101.42 led to managed identity token theft and mailbox data access
summary: Between 2026-07-17 22:58:30 and 22:58:32, a confirmed malicious sequence progressed through device-code initial access, IMDS token acquisition from webapp-vm-001, and repeated mailbox access against victim@contoso.com. Sensitive data access/exfiltration is confirmed. Observable scope in report: 1 public IP, 1 cloud app, 1 managed identity, 1 virtual machine, 1 mailbox, 6 events, 6 correlated alerts.

items.title: Incident verdict
items.detail: Incident classified as True Positive / Other.

items.title: Confirmed malicious attack with successful sensitive data access
items.detail: The incident is classified as True Positive / Other because confirmed malicious attack with successful sensitive data access.

items.title: Data access/exfiltration confirmed
items.detail: Report states data access/exfiltration confirmed.

items.title: Incident time window
items.detail: Observed activity occurred from 2026-07-17 22:58:30 to 2026-07-17 22:58:32.

items.title: Total observable events
items.detail: Total observable events in report: 6.

items.title: Source public IP
items.detail: Public IP 185.220.101.42 observed in initial access and subsequent activity.

items.title: Device-code authentication completed
items.detail: AADSignInLogs recorded device code authentication completed from 185.220.101.42 to app d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c (ResourceDisplayName=Device Code App). Alert: IA-ALERT-001.

items.title: Managed identity token obtained via IMDS
items.detail: AzureIMDSAccessLogs recorded successful IMDS.GetToken from 185.220.101.42 against webapp-vm-001 for resource hxxps://graph[.]microsoft[.]com using managed identity 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555. Alert: IA-ALERT-002.

items.title: Mailbox accessed at 22:58:31
items.detail: OfficeActivity recorded MailItemsAccessed against victim@contoso.com with OperationCount=3. Alerts: IA-ALERT-003, IA-ALERT-004, IA-ALERT-005, IA-ALERT-006.

items.title: Mailbox accessed at 22:58:32 via AppId bf639aa2-d2f3-4a61-96e7-3938ded3cf02
items.detail: OfficeActivity recorded MailItemsAccessed against victim@contoso.com with OperationCount=3.

items.title: Mailbox accessed at 22:58:32 via AppId 8b0501d4-7825-4e2c-9c97-453f1bc6f6b3
items.detail: OfficeActivity recorded MailItemsAccessed against victim@contoso.com with OperationCount=3.

items.title: Mailbox accessed at 22:58:32 via AppId f6db002e-f2be-4a5b-a809-1936272a6631
items.detail: OfficeActivity recorded MailItemsAccessed against victim@contoso.com with OperationCount=3.

items.title: Compromised cloud app
items.detail: Cloud App d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c marked Compromised; evidence ties it to device-code sign-in from 185.220.101.42.

items.title: Compromised managed identity
items.detail: Managed identity 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555 marked Compromised after successful IMDS token access for hxxps://graph[.]microsoft[.]com from webapp-vm-001.

items.title: Affected virtual machine
items.detail: Virtual machine /SUBSCRIPTIONS/12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789ABC/RESOURCEGROUPS/PRODUCTION-RG/PROVIDERS/MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/VIRTUALMACHINES/WEBAPP-VM-001 (webapp-vm-001) marked Affected.

items.title: Affected mailbox
items.detail: Mailbox victim@contoso.com marked Affected and targeted during collection.

items.title: T1566.002 Phishing: Spearphishing Link (Device Code)
items.detail: Initial access evidenced by device code authentication completed from 185.220.101.42.

items.title: T1552.005 Unsecured Credentials: Cloud Instance Metadata API
items.detail: Credential access evidenced by successful IMDS.GetToken from 185.220.101.42 against webapp-vm-001.

items.title: T1114.002 Remote Email Collection
items.detail: Collection evidenced by successful MailItemsAccessed operations against victim@contoso.com.

items.title: Attack path summary
items.detail: Attack graph shows 185.220.101.42 gained initial access via cloud app d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c, stole token from webapp-vm-001, and accessed mailbox victim@contoso.com.

items.title: Correlated alerts
items.detail: Six correlated alerts in the original incident: IA-ALERT-001 through IA-ALERT-006, all with verdict True Positive.

items.title: Affected entity count in report
items.detail: Observable entities listed in report: 1 public IP, 1 cloud app, 1 managed identity, 1 virtual machine, 1 mailbox.

items.title: Immediate containment focus
items.detail: Prioritize containment and review of the reported compromised/affected assets: cloud app d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c, managed identity 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555, webapp-vm-001, and mailbox victim@contoso.com.
